subject.title: feat(android): add cron job management controls

question: Should PR #101882 keep the dedicated Android Cron Management Proof workflow, or should cron proof be folded into existing Android validation before merge?
rationale: The workflow creates a new durable GitHub Actions lane with branch-specific triggers and Android SDK setup, so automation ownership and maintenance cost are maintainer decisions that code review cannot settle from the patch alone.

options.title: Fold into existing Android validation
options.body: Move the cron screenshot/proof coverage into the existing Android validation path and remove the standalone branch-triggered workflow from this PR.

options.title: Keep the dedicated workflow
options.body: Accept the ongoing maintenance cost of a feature-specific Android proof lane after an owner confirms it is the desired CI surface.

options.title: Split automation out
options.body: Land the app feature separately and handle the workflow addition in a smaller owner-reviewed follow-up.

recommendation.title: Fold into existing Android validation
recommendation.body: Move the cron screenshot/proof coverage into the existing Android validation path and remove the standalone branch-triggered workflow from this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest recent Android area contributor in the ownership evidence and is best placed to decide whether this Android-specific workflow belongs in-repo.
